name: admin-web
description: shuai-tunnel 管理后台前端 (React + HeroUI)

scripts.build: npm run sync:schemas && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.deploy:all: npm run build && node scripts/deploy.mjs --target all
scripts.deploy:java: npm run build && node scripts/deploy.mjs --target java
scripts.deploy:go: npm run build && node scripts/deploy.mjs --target go
scripts.deploy:csharp: npm run build && node scripts/deploy.mjs --target csharp
